units.source_text: 洛中流窜的匪徒里，多襄丸还是个色鬼。

en.t: Among the bandits roaming through the capital, Tajomaru was still known as a lecher.

units.source_text: 去年秋天的时候，据说就是他在后山杀害了来鸟部寺宝头卢烧香的妇女和丫鬟。

en.t: Last autumn, they say, he killed a woman and her maid on the hill behind the temple when they had come to Toribedera to burn incense before Binzuru.

units.source_text: 这次这个男人又被他杀了，骑马的女人很可能也被他掠走了，也不知道她怎么样了。

en.t: This time he seems to have killed this man as well, and the woman on horseback was very likely carried off by him too; no one knows what became of her.

units.source_text: 恕我多言，希望您也可以调查一下这件事。

en.t: Forgive me for saying so, but I hope you will look into this matter as well.
